test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The analysis of a person's handwriting to determine his/her personality
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Graphology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Graphology** refers to the study and analysis of a person's handwriting to deduce their personality traits, behavior, and psychological state. (हस्तलेखन के आधार पर व्यक्तित्व का अध्ययन)

 
 
• **Example: **Graphology is often used in recruitment processes to understand a candidate's personality better.
 
 
 
• **Numismatics** pertains to the study or collection of coins, paper currency, and medals. (मुद्राओं का अध्ययन)
 
 
• **Example:** His passion for numismatics has helped him build an impressive collection of ancient coins.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Graphology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Numismatics** (मुद्राशास्त्र): The study or collection of currency such as coins, tokens, and paper money.

 
 
• **Example:** The museum's numismatics section has coins from the Mughal period.
 
 
 
• **Philology** (भाषाशास्त्र): The study of language in written historical sources; it is a combination of literary studies, history, and linguistics.
 
 
• **Example:** Her research in philology revealed new insights into ancient texts.
 
 
 
• **Calligraphy** (सुलेख): The art of writing beautifully with a pen or brush.
 
 
• **Example:** She practiced calligraphy to improve her handwriting and make it more artistic.
